{{Top|leg}}
'''Coruscanticentric''' was a term used to describe anything that was based on the culture of [[Coruscanti/Legends|Coruscanti]] natives. This was popular among many peoples of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], but not so much with beings from outside the Core, who did not want to deal with the ideals of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].
